data.exact_reserve_text: As a result, the claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years. During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on Professional Indemnity, Directors & Officers and Medical Malpractice
prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant increase in the incurred claims position on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes leading to a material strengthening of claims reserves on 2013 and prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the Syndicate materially strengthened its claims reserves, driven principally by adverse development on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice business originating in 2013 and prior years. An independent review of open claims led to a significant increase in incurred claims estimates and consequent reserve strengthening, producing a large adverse prior-year movement concentrated in professional lines.
raw_causal_phrases: claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
significant increase in the incurred claims position on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
high degree of uncertainty over the outcome of many claims and therefore wide variability in the possible outcomes
deterioration in the loss ratios arising in the 2013 and prior years
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year development (gross) taken from the 'Changes for prior years' gross figure in Technical Provisions reconciliation (Note 17). The report also discloses net adverse development (GBP 34.5m) for 2013 & prior; gross figure used where available. Premiums and triangle values in the report are presented in GBP '000 and have been converted to millions where required. Line-of-business mapping to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate for professional liability classes.
